main_text.head: EPIST. IV.
main_text.p: Joan. Morinus Clar. viro Hieronymo Aleandro de diversis Scripturae Samaritanae Characteribus, qui in diversis eorum libris reperiuntur.

p.i: Clarissimo & Doctissimo viro Hieronymo Aleandro Joannes Morinus S. D.

main_text.p: EOdem fere momento, quo mihi reddita est Epistola tua, allata mihi sunt exemplaria duodecim Praefationis, quam editioni Bibliorum Graecorum Sixti V. Pontificis Parisiis recens recusae praepo-sui; non plura curaveram extra ordinem numerumque Bibliopolis confve-

page.notes: No marginal notes. Long s is printed as plain s throughout. Printed "qvos", "qvia", "qvo" and "qvam" were normalised to quos, quia, quo and quam. The catchword "tum" closes the page. The word "confve-" is partly obscured at the line end; its letters are uncertain. The word "sui" (printed "fui") is also uncertain and may be read as "sui".
